Guide Reference

API Reference

Use this reference to integrate with the Example API.

Getting started

Create a project and request an access token.

Install

Install the client with the package manager of your choice.

Configuration

Store credentials outside source control.

Authentication

Every request must include a bearer token.

API keys

Keys are scoped to a single project.

Scopes

Request only the scopes your integration needs.

Endpoints

Endpoints are grouped by resource type.

Users

Read and update user records.

Projects

Projects contain API keys and configuration.

Pagination

List endpoints return paginated results.

Cursors

Pass the cursor from the previous response.

Errors

Errors include a machine-readable code.

Rate limits

Retry after the period indicated in the response.

Validation

Invalid fields are reported by path.

Webhooks

Webhooks notify your service about changes.

Retries

Failed deliveries are retried with backoff.

Signatures

Verify the signature before trusting a payload.

Versioning

Breaking changes are released in new versions.

Deprecation

Deprecated fields remain available during a migration window.

Changelog

Review the changelog before upgrading.

Support

Contact support with your project identifier.

Status

Check the status page for current availability.
